notes: VRAM breakdown is a documented estimate, not a profiler measurement.

Parameter count recomputed from the `large` preset with vocabulary 151,643 and context 2048: 421.15M, matching the run's model card (421.1M); the '350M' monitor banner and '~333M' preset table were wrong.

The documented ~14 h wall clock is not consistent with 491M tokens at 20.7k tok/s (≈6.6 h of compute); it includes evaluation, checkpointing and three documented incidents with restarts (network-filesystem checkpoint corruption, disk exhaustion, OOM on resume). Do not derive throughput from it.
The torch.compile comparison (~20.8k vs ~15k tok/s) is an observation from the monitor, not a controlled A/B run.

Loss values carry forward: token cross-entropy, AdamW with matrix-only decay, cosine schedule with warmup and bf16 autocast are unchanged. Throughput and generation speed were measured with the original implementation of the same architecture; Forgeline's model code has not been timed on an A40.
